title: spatial ARC-style induction: four-slot toroidal wave encoding, D4 invariant router, CEGIS operator chains

encoding.basis: fixed orthogonal toroidal Fourier basis per slot

rows.name: z3_contradiction_two_outputs
rows.reason: ABSTAIN: unsatisfiable specification (one input, two outputs)

rows.name: z3_contradiction_colour_only
rows.authored: one input, two outputs differing in one colour
rows.reason: ABSTAIN: unsatisfiable specification (one input, two outputs)

rows.name: z3_contradiction_shape_violation
rows.authored: one input, one shape-preserving and one tiled output
rows.reason: ABSTAIN: unsatisfiable specification (one input, two outputs)

rows.name: z3_contradiction_declared_shape
rows.authored: an output shape that violates the declared shape rule
rows.reason: ABSTAIN: a pair violates the declared shape rule

contradictions.policy: fail-closed: duplicate input/outputs or a violated declared shape facet refuses before any search node is spent

budget.unified: one budget per task across every ranked sketch and both stages
budget.node_definition: one operator-chain execution on one training pair
budget.repulsor_policy: a refuted chain is recorded as a REPULSOR axiom (cap 64) and an identical chain is never executed twice; duplicate proposals are pruned before they cost a node

wave_calls.note: encoder invocations are counted by the encoder itself; the router ran once per task, once per task again for the test-invariance check, and once for the budget-enforcement probe

text_tokens.source: every task is passed as integer numpy arrays; no character stream, tokenizer or vocabulary enters the inducer
text_tokens.measured: str-valued entries in the example and test pairs of all 20 specs

disclosure: the sixteen tasks in this script and the operator library in henri/holarch/spatial_induction.py share an author; the tasks are stored in this script so the inducer cannot special-case them
